violations.text: The hand sink in the kitchen was observed unable to use hot or cold water. Knobs were observed unscrewed. Hand sink to be repaired. Hand sink in the bar area was observed unable to use the hot water knob. Hand sink to be repaired. New Violation. Correct By: 12/08/2026

The door to the outside, located next to the kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 12/08/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of bio-film. Ice machine to be emptied and washed rinsed and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 11/24/2026

Food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed with an accumulation of bio-film. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC disposed of ice. Ice machine to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized before use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/03/2025

Food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed with an accumulation of biofilm. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice was disposed of. Ice machine must be washed, rinsed, and sanitzed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/19/2024

The cutting boards in the kitchen are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. Cutting board was disposed of. New Violation. Correct By: 03/19/2024
